notes: Statistics retained as printed. Original and replication tests extracted independently. No metric conversion. Original uses one-tailed directional tests. Replication presents audiovisual stimuli; source tables label outcome lists but methods and scoring concern item/order recall. General Discussion p. r10 incorrectly says the original had no suppression effect; original p. 17 prints a significant suppression main effect. Abstract explicitly says suppression did not replicate; failed maps that stated verdict.
